what: Paper Land - Godot 4.7.2 Paper.io 2 style territory game (GL Compatibility, web no-threads export). Rebuild: recreate these files, python3 tools/make_sfx.py, fonts assets/fonts/russo.ttf exo400.ttf exo700.ttf symbols.ttf (same as Sky Captain: @fontsource russo-one/exo-2 latin -> TTF via fontTools; symbols = DejaVuSans-Bold subset), icon.png any PNG. godot --headless --path . --import ; bash tools/check.sh ; godot --headless --path . -- --selftest ; bash tools/export.sh (writes ../build-paper, splits wasm into 3 parts, index.pck -> index.pck.wasm; export.sh wipes the folder so regenerate src.json after). Note: project.godot must have textures/vram_compression/import_etc2_astc=true or the web export fails with an empty config error. Debug hashes: #play #touch.

extends Node
## Paper Land - menus, camera, input, HUD, audio.

const SAVE := "user://paper_land.cfg"

var game: Game
var cam: Camera2D
var ui: CanvasLayer
var screens: Dictionary = {}
var font_t: Font
var font: Font
var font_b: Font
var state := "title"
var skin := 0
var eyes := "normal"
var pname := "YOU"
var bots := 7
var sound_on := true
var save := ConfigFile.new()
var best_pct := 0.0
var best_time := 0.0
var total_kills := 0
var sfx: Dictionary = {}
var pool: Array = []
var hud: Control
var joy_active := false
var joy_center := Vector2.ZERO
var joy_pos := Vector2.ZERO
var joy_id := -1
var key_dir := Vector2.ZERO
var mouse_down := false
var selftest := false
var zoom := 1.0
var shake := 0.0
var hud_labels: Dictionary = {}
var skin_buttons: Array = []
var eye_buttons: Array = []
var last_pct_milestone := 0
var touch_mode := false

func _ready() -> void:
	font_t = load("res://assets/fonts/russo.ttf")
	font = load("res://assets/fonts/exo400.ttf")
	font_b = load("res://assets/fonts/exo700.ttf")
	var sym: Font = load("res://assets/fonts/symbols.ttf")
	font_t.fallbacks = [sym]
	font.fallbacks = [sym]
	font_b.fallbacks = [sym]
	_load_save()
	var args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
	var screen := ""
	for a in args:
		if a == "--check":
			print("CHECK OK")
			get_tree().quit()
			return
		if a == "--selftest":
			selftest = true
		if a.begins_with("--screen="):
			screen = a.substr(9)
	_load_sfx()
	game = Game.new()
	game.font = font
	game.font_b = font_b
	game.sfx_cb = Callable(self, "_game_sfx")
	add_child(game)
	game.player_died.connect(_on_player_died)
	game.captured.connect(_on_captured)
	game.killed_someone.connect(_on_kill)
	cam = Camera2D.new()
	cam.zoom = Vector2(1.0, 1.0)
	add_child(cam)
	cam.make_current()
	_build_ui()
	if selftest:
		_run_selftest()
		return
	match screen:
		"play":
			_start()
		"touch":
			touch_mode = true
			_start()
		_:
			_show("title")

func _load_save() -> void:
	if save.load(SAVE) == OK:
		skin = save.get_value("g", "skin", 0)
		eyes = save.get_value("g", "eyes", "normal")
		pname = save.get_value("g", "name", "YOU")
		sound_on = save.get_value("g", "sound", true)
		best_pct = save.get_value("g", "best_pct", 0.0)
		best_time = save.get_value("g", "best_time", 0.0)
		total_kills = save.get_value("g", "kills", 0)
		bots = save.get_value("g", "bots", 7)

func _save() -> void:
	save.set_value("g", "skin", skin)
	save.set_value("g", "eyes", eyes)
	save.set_value("g", "name", pname)
	save.set_value("g", "sound", sound_on)
	save.set_value("g", "best_pct", best_pct)
	save.set_value("g", "best_time", best_time)
	save.set_value("g", "kills", total_kills)
	save.set_value("g", "bots", bots)
	save.save(SAVE)

func _load_sfx() -> void:
	for nm in ["capture", "bigcapture", "kill", "die", "click", "win", "tick", "boost"]:
		sfx[nm] = load("res://assets/sfx/%s.wav" % nm)
	for i in range(6):
		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		add_child(p)
		pool.append(p)

func play(nm: String, vol: float = 0.0, pitch: float = 1.0) -> void:
	if not sound_on or not sfx.has(nm):
		return
	for p in pool:
		if not p.playing:
			p.stream = sfx[nm]
			p.volume_db = vol
			p.pitch_scale = pitch
			p.play()
			return

func _game_sfx(what: String) -> void:
	if what == "kill_far":
		play("kill", -14.0, 0.8)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui helpers
func _style(col: Color, border: Color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35)) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = col
	sb.border_color = border
	sb.set_border_width_all(2)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	sb.set_content_margin_all(8)
	return sb

func _button(txt: String, size: Vector2, col: Color = Color(0.25, 0.5, 0.95), fs: int = 20) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.text = txt
	b.custom_minimum_size = size
	b.add_theme_font_override("font", font_t)
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _style(col))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _style(col.lightened(0.15)))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _style(col.darkened(0.2), Color(1, 1, 1)))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _style(col))
	for k in ["font_color", "font_hover_color", "font_pressed_color", "font_focus_color"]:
		b.add_theme_color_override(k, Color(1, 1, 1))
	b.pressed.connect(func(): play("click", -8.0))
	return b

func _label(txt: String, fs: int = 18, f: Font = null, col: Color = Color(0.15, 0.15, 0.2)) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = txt
	l.add_theme_font_override("font", f if f else font)
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", fs)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", col)
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	return l

func _screen(nm: String) -> Control:
	var c := Control.new()
	c.name = nm
	c.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	c.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	c.visible = false
	ui.add_child(c)
	screens[nm] = c
	return c

func _panel(parent: Control, w: float) -> VBoxContainer:
	var cc := CenterContainer.new()
	cc.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	parent.add_child(cc)
	var p := PanelContainer.new()
	p.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _style(Color(1, 1, 1, 0.93), Color(0.25, 0.5, 0.95, 0.6)))
	p.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(w, 0)
	cc.add_child(p)
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	p.add_child(v)
	return v

func _build_ui() -> void:
	ui = CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(ui)
	# title
	var ti := _screen("title")
	var tv := _panel(ti, 640.0)
	tv.add_child(_label("PAPER LAND", 56, font_t, Color(0.25, 0.5, 0.95)))
	tv.add_child(_label("Grab land. Cut tails. Own the map.", 18, font_b, Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.5)))
	# name
	var nh := HBoxContainer.new()
	nh.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	nh.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	tv.add_child(nh)
	nh.add_child(_label("Name:", 18, font_b))
	var ne := LineEdit.new()
	ne.text = pname
	ne.max_length = 10
	ne.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(200, 40)
	ne.add_theme_font_override("font", font_b)
	ne.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
	ne.text_changed.connect(func(t):
		pname = t.strip_edges() if t.strip_edges() != "" else "YOU"
		_save())
	nh.add_child(ne)
	# skins
	tv.add_child(_label("Pick your colour", 15, font_b, Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.5)))
	var sh := HBoxContainer.new()
	sh.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	sh.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	tv.add_child(sh)
	skin_buttons.clear()
	for i in range(Game.SKINS.size()):
		var b := Button.new()
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(44, 44)
		var col: Color = Game.SKINS[i].col
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _style(col, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.15)))
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _style(col.lightened(0.2), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.3)))
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _style(col, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.8)))
		b.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _style(col, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.15)))
		var idx := i
		b.pressed.connect(func():
			skin = idx
			play("click", -8.0)
			_refresh_title()
			_save())
		sh.add_child(b)
		skin_buttons.append(b)
	# eyes
	tv.add_child(_label("Pick your face", 15, font_b, Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.5)))
	var eh := HBoxContainer.new()
	eh.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	eh.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	tv.add_child(eh)
	eye_buttons.clear()
	for e in Game.EYES:
		var eb := _button(e.to_upper(), Vector2(100, 40), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6), 14)
		var en: String = e
		eb.pressed.connect(func():
			eyes = en
			_refresh_title()
			_save())
		eh.add_child(eb)
		eye_buttons.append(eb)
	# bots count
	var bh := HBoxContainer.new()
	bh.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	bh.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	tv.add_child(bh)
	var bl := _label("Players: %d" % (bots + 1), 16, font_b)
	bl.name = "BotsLabel"
	var bm := _button("−", Vector2(44, 40), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6), 18)
	bm.pressed.connect(func():
		bots = max(2, bots - 1)
		bl.text = "Players: %d" % (bots + 1)
		_save())
	var bp := _button("+", Vector2(44, 40), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6), 18)
	bp.pressed.connect(func():
		bots = min(9, bots + 1)
		bl.text = "Players: %d" % (bots + 1)
		_save())
	bh.add_child(bm)
	bh.add_child(bl)
	bh.add_child(bp)
	var ph := HBoxContainer.new()
	ph.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	ph.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	tv.add_child(ph)
	var playb := _button("PLAY  ▶", Vector2(260, 60), Color(0.95, 0.5, 0.15), 28)
	playb.pressed.connect(func(): _start())
	ph.add_child(playb)
	var sb := _button("SOUND: ON", Vector2(150, 60), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6), 16)
	sb.name = "SoundBtn"
	sb.pressed.connect(func():
		sound_on = not sound_on
		sb.text = "SOUND: " + ("ON" if sound_on else "OFF")
		_save())
	ph.add_child(sb)
	var bst := _label("", 15, font_b, Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.5))
	bst.name = "Best"
	tv.add_child(bst)
	tv.add_child(_label("Move: drag anywhere (iPad), arrows/WASD or mouse. Go out, make a loop, come back to your colour to grab the land inside. Touch a tail to cut that player. Don't touch your own tail or the wall!", 13, font, Color(0.45, 0.45, 0.55)))
	tv.get_child(tv.get_child_count() - 1).autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	# HUD
	var pl := _screen("play")
	hud = Control.new()
	hud.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	hud.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	pl.add_child(hud)
	hud.draw.connect(_draw_hud)
	var pauseb := _button("II", Vector2(46, 42), Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.4, 0.7), 16)
	pauseb.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_RIGHT)
	pauseb.position = Vector2(-62, 14)
	pauseb.pressed.connect(func(): _pause())
	pl.add_child(pauseb)
	# pause
	var pa := _screen("pause")
	var pv := _panel(pa, 420.0)
	pv.add_child(_label("PAUSED", 36, font_t, Color(0.25, 0.5, 0.95)))
	var rb := _button("CONTINUE", Vector2(280, 54), Color(0.95, 0.5, 0.15), 22)
	rb.pressed.connect(func(): _resume())
	pv.add_child(rb)
	var qb := _button("QUIT TO MENU", Vector2(280, 48), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6), 18)
	qb.pressed.connect(func():
		game.running = false
		_show("title"))
	pv.add_child(qb)
	# game over
	var go := _screen("over")
	var gv := _panel(go, 520.0)
	var gt := _label("YOU GOT CUT!", 38, font_t, Color(0.93, 0.28, 0.3))
	gt.name = "Title"
	gv.add_child(gt)
	var gl := _label("", 18, font)
	gl.name = "Lines"
	gl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	gv.add_child(gl)
	var gh := HBoxContainer.new()
	gh.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	gh.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	gv.add_child(gh)
	var again := _button("PLAY AGAIN", Vector2(220, 56), Color(0.95, 0.5, 0.15), 22)
	again.pressed.connect(func(): _start())
	gh.add_child(again)
	var menu := _button("MENU", Vector2(150, 56), Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6), 18)
	menu.pressed.connect(func(): _show("title"))
	gh.add_child(menu)

func _refresh_title() -> void:
	for i in range(skin_buttons.size()):
		var b: Button = skin_buttons[i]
		b.text = "✓" if i == skin else ""
		b.add_theme_font_override("font", font_b)
		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
		b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1))
	for i in range(eye_buttons.size()):
		var eb: Button = eye_buttons[i]
		var sel: bool = Game.EYES[i] == eyes
		var col := Color(0.25, 0.5, 0.95) if sel else Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.6)
		eb.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _style(col))
		eb.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _style(col.lightened(0.15)))
	var sb: Button = screens["title"].find_child("SoundBtn", true, false)
	sb.text = "SOUND: " + ("ON" if sound_on else "OFF")
	var bst: Label = screens["title"].find_child("Best", true, false)
	bst.text = "Best: %.1f%% of the map  ·  Longest life: %d:%02d  ·  Tails cut: %d" % [best_pct, int(best_time) / 60, int(best_time) % 60, total_kills]

func _show(nm: String) -> void:
	for k in screens:
		screens[k].visible = (k == nm)
	state = nm
	if nm == "title":
		_refresh_title()
		game.running = false
		# show a demo board behind the menu
		if game.players.is_empty():
			game.setup(skin, eyes, pname, bots)
			game.running = true
			game.players[0].alive = false
			game.players[0].respawn = 1e9
		cam.zoom = Vector2(0.9, 0.9)
		cam.position = Vector2(Game.N * Game.CELL * 0.5, Game.N * Game.CELL * 0.5)

func _start() -> void:
	game.setup(skin, eyes, pname, bots)
	last_pct_milestone = 0
	zoom = 1.8
	joy_active = false
	key_dir = Vector2.ZERO
	_show("play")
	cam.zoom = Vector2(zoom, zoom)
	cam.position = game.player().pos * Game.CELL

func _pause() -> void:
	if state != "play":
		return
	game.running = false
	_show("pause")

func _resume() -> void:
	_show("play")
	game.running = true

func _on_player_died(by: String) -> void:
	play("die")
	shake = 0.6
	var t := game.time_alive
	var p := game.pct(game.player_id)
	var lines: Array = []
	lines.append("Cut by %s." % by if by != "the wall" else "You hit the wall.")
	lines.append("You owned %.1f%% of the map and lived %d:%02d." % [p, int(t) / 60, int(t) % 60])
	lines.append("Rank #%d of %d  ·  Tails cut: %d" % [game.player_rank(), game.players.size(), game.kills])
	var newbest := false
	if p > best_pct:
		best_pct = p
		newbest = true
	if t > best_time:
		best_time = t
		newbest = true
	total_kills += game.kills
	if newbest:
		lines.append("NEW BEST!")
	_save()
	var go: Control = screens["over"]
	var tl: Label = go.find_child("Title", true, false)
	tl.text = "YOU GOT CUT!" if by != "the wall" else "OUCH, THE WALL!"
	if by.ends_with("own tail"):
		tl.text = "YOUR OWN TAIL!"
	var ll: Label = go.find_child("Lines", true, false)
	ll.text = "\n".join(lines)
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.2).timeout
	_show("over")

func _on_captured(cells: int, is_player: bool) -> void:
	if not is_player:
		return
	if cells >= 150:
		play("bigcapture", -2.0)
		shake = 0.25
	else:
		play("capture", -6.0, 0.9 + min(cells, 100) / 200.0)
	var p := game.pct(game.player_id)
	var ms := int(p / 10.0)
	if ms > last_pct_milestone:
		last_pct_milestone = ms
		play("win", -4.0)
		game._popup(game.player().pos, "%d%% OF THE MAP!" % (ms * 10), Color(0.25, 0.5, 0.95))

func _on_kill(victim: String) -> void:
	play("kill", -2.0)
	shake = 0.3

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- input
func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if e is InputEventKey and e.pressed and not e.echo:
		if e.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			if state == "play":
				_pause()
			elif state == "pause":
				_resume()
		if state == "over" and e.keycode == KEY_ENTER:
			_start()

func _input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state != "play":
		return
	if e is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if e.pressed and joy_id == -1:
			joy_id = e.index
			joy_center = e.position
			joy_pos = e.position
			joy_active = true
		elif not e.pressed and e.index == joy_id:
			joy_id = -1
			joy_active = false
	elif e is InputEventScreenDrag and e.index == joy_id:
		joy_pos = e.position
		var d := joy_pos - joy_center
		if d.length() > 70.0:
			joy_center = joy_pos - d.normalized() * 70.0
	elif e is InputEventMouseMotion and joy_active and joy_id == -1:
		pass

func _process(dt: float) -> void:
	if state == "play" and game.running:
		var p := game.player()
		var dir := Vector2.ZERO
		if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W):
			dir.y -= 1.0
		if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S):
			dir.y += 1.0
		if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A):
			dir.x -= 1.0
		if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D):
			dir.x += 1.0
		if dir != Vector2.ZERO:
			game.set_player_want(dir.angle())
		elif joy_active:
			var d := joy_pos - joy_center
			if d.length() > 8.0:
				game.set_player_want(d.angle())
		# zoom out a bit as you own more land
		var want_zoom: float = clamp(1.8 - game.pct(game.player_id) * 0.025, 1.0, 1.8)
		zoom = lerp(zoom, want_zoom, dt * 2.0)
		cam.zoom = Vector2(zoom, zoom)
		var target: Vector2 = p.pos * Game.CELL
		cam.position = cam.position.lerp(target, min(1.0, dt * 8.0))
	if shake > 0.0:
		shake -= dt
		cam.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-6, 6), randf_range(-6, 6)) * shake
	else:
		cam.offset = Vector2.ZERO
	if hud and hud.visible:
		hud.queue_redraw()
	# keep the demo board alive behind menus
	if state in ["title", "over", "pause"] and game.players.size() > 0 and state == "title":
		game.running = true
		cam.position = cam.position.lerp(Vector2(Game.N * Game.CELL * 0.5, Game.N * Game.CELL * 0.5), dt)

func _draw_hud() -> void:
	var sz := hud.get_viewport_rect().size
	var compact := sz.x < 900.0
	# my land %
	var pct := game.pct(game.player_id)
	var col: Color = game.player().col
	hud.draw_rect(Rect2(14, 14, 230, 58), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85))
	hud.draw_rect(Rect2(14, 14, 230, 58), col, false, 3.0)
	hud.draw_string(font_t, Vector2(24, 52), "%.2f%%" % pct, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 30, col)
	hud.draw_string(font_b, Vector2(150, 40), "of the map", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 13, Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.5))
	hud.draw_string(font_b, Vector2(150, 60), "#%d  %d:%02d" % [game.player_rank(), int(game.time_alive) / 60, int(game.time_alive) % 60], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14, Color(0.4, 0.4, 0.5))
	# leaderboard
	var lx := sz.x - 214.0 - 70.0
	var ly := 14.0
	var rows: int = min(5, game.rank_cache.size())
	hud.draw_rect(Rect2(lx, ly, 214, 12 + rows * 24), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85))
	for i in range(rows):
		var r: Array = game.rank_cache[i]
		var y := ly + 24.0 + i * 24.0
		hud.draw_rect(Rect2(lx + 10, y - 13, 14, 14), r[2])
		var nm: String = r[1]
		if r[3] == game.player_id:
			nm = "YOU"
		hud.draw_string(font_b, Vector2(lx + 30, y), "%d. %s" % [i + 1, nm], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, 110, 14, Color(0.15, 0.15, 0.2) if r[4] else Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.65))
		hud.draw_string(font_b, Vector2(lx + 140, y), "%.1f%%" % (100.0 * r[0] / float(Game.N * Game.N)), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, 64, 14, Color(0.15, 0.15, 0.2))
	# joystick
	if joy_active:
		hud.draw_circle(joy_center, 60.0, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
		hud.draw_arc(joy_center, 60.0, 0, TAU, 40, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6), 2.0)
		var d := joy_pos - joy_center
		if d.length() > 60.0:
			d = d.normalized() * 60.0
		hud.draw_circle(joy_center + d, 24.0, Color(col, 0.9))
	# tail warning: when far from home
	var p := game.player()
	if p.alive and p.trail_cells.size() > 25:
		var a := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(game.time_alive * 10.0)
		hud.draw_string(font_t, Vector2(sz.x * 0.5 - 150, 110), "LONG TAIL - GO HOME!", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 300, 20, Color(0.93, 0.28, 0.3, a))
	# minimap
	var ms := 110.0 if not compact else 80.0
	var mr := Rect2(sz.x - ms - 16.0, sz.y - ms - 16.0, ms, ms)
	hud.draw_rect(mr, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
	hud.draw_texture_rect(game.tex, mr, false)
	hud.draw_rect(mr, Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.4), false, 2.0)
	for q in game.players:
		if q.alive:
			var mp: Vector2 = mr.position + q.pos / float(Game.N) * ms
			hud.draw_circle(mp, 3.0 if q.id != game.player_id else 4.0, q.col if q.id != game.player_id else Color(1, 1, 1))
			if q.id == game.player_id:
				hud.draw_circle(mp, 2.5, q.col)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- self test
func _run_selftest() -> void:
	var fails := 0
	game.setup(0, "normal", "BOT", 7)
	var p := game.player()
	# drive the player in a square loop: 10 cells out, 10 across, back
	var dt := 1.0 / 60.0
	var start_count := game.counts[0]
	var legs := [0.0, PI * 0.5, PI, -PI * 0.5]
	p.heading = 0.0
	p.want = 0.0
	var t := 0.0
	var leg := 0
	var leg_t := 0.0
	while t < 20.0 and p.alive and leg < 5:
		game._process(dt)
		t += dt
		leg_t += dt
		if leg_t > 10.0 / Game.SPEED:
			leg_t = 0.0
			leg += 1
			if leg < 4:
				p.want = legs[leg]
	var got := game.counts[0] - start_count
	var ok1: bool = p.alive and got > 50
	print("%s loop capture: +%d cells (%.2f%%), alive=%s, t=%.1f" % ["PASS" if ok1 else "FAIL", got, game.pct(0), p.alive, t])
	if not ok1:
		fails += 1
	# bots survive and capture over 60 s
	var t2 := 0.0
	while t2 < 60.0:
		game._process(dt)
		t2 += dt
	var bot_land := 0
	var bot_alive := 0
	for q in game.players:
		if q.bot:
			bot_land += game.counts[q.id]
			bot_alive += 1 if q.alive else 0
	var ok2 := bot_land > 500
	print("%s bots after 60 s: %d cells total (%.1f%% of map), alive %d/7, player alive=%s" % ["PASS" if ok2 else "FAIL", bot_land, 100.0 * bot_land / float(Game.N * Game.N), bot_alive, p.alive])
	if not ok2:
		fails += 1
	# wall death
	if p.alive:
		p.want = PI
		p.heading = PI
		var t3 := 0.0
		while t3 < 60.0 and p.alive:
			game._process(dt)
			t3 += dt
		print("%s wall death after %.1f s" % ["PASS" if not p.alive else "FAIL", t3])
		if p.alive:
			fails += 1
	# capture timing
	game.setup(0, "normal", "BOT", 7)
	var tm := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	p = game.player()
	p.trail_cells.append(p.cell)
	game._capture(p)
	print("capture flood fill: %.1f ms" % ((Time.get_ticks_usec() - tm) / 1000.0))
	print("SELFTEST " + ("PASS" if fails == 0 else "FAIL (%d)" % fails))
	get_tree().quit(0 if fails == 0 else 1)

import math, random, struct, wave, os
SR=22050; OUT=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),"assets","sfx"); os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True); random.seed(3)
def save(n,s):
    m=max(1e-6,max(abs(x) for x in s)); d=b"".join(struct.pack("<h",int(max(-1,min(1,x/m))*29000)) for x in s)
    w=wave.open(os.path.join(OUT,n+".wav"),"wb"); w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(d); w.close(); print(n)
def env(i,n,a,r):
    t=i/SR; e=min(1,t/a) if a>0 else 1; rem=(n-i)/SR
    return e*(rem/r if rem<r else 1)
def tone(freqs,dur,decay=4.0,wave_fn=math.sin):
    n=int(SR*dur); s=[]
    for i in range(n):
        t=i/SR; v=0
        for k,f in enumerate(freqs):
            st=k*0.07
            if t>st: v+=wave_fn(2*math.pi*f*(t-st))*math.exp(-(t-st)*decay)
        s.append(v)
    return s

#!/bin/bash
# Export the web build to ../build-paper and split the wasm into 15 MB parts.
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
rm -rf ../build-paper && mkdir -p ../build-paper
timeout 600 godot --headless --path . --export-release Web ../build-paper/index.html 2>&1 | grep -vE "^$|Godot Engine|X11|display" || true
cd ../build-paper
ls -la
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, re
w = open('index.wasm','rb').read()
LIM = 15 * 1024 * 1024 - 4096
parts = [w[i:i+LIM] for i in range(0, len(w), LIM)]
assert len(parts) <= 3, len(parts)
for i, p in enumerate(parts):
    open('index.part%d.wasm' % (i+1), 'wb').write(p)
os.remove('index.wasm')
os.rename('index.pck', 'index.pck.wasm')
h = open('index.html').read()
# strip html/head/body wrappers (the artifact host adds its own skeleton)
h = re.sub(r'^\s*<!DOCTYPE html>\s*', '', h)
h = re.sub(r'<html[^>]*>', '', h); h = h.replace('</html>', '')
h = h.replace('<head>', '').replace('</head>', '').replace('<body>', '').replace('</body>', '')
open('index.html','w').write(h.strip() + '\n')
print('parts', len(parts), [len(p) for p in parts])
PY
ls -la
